This directory contains the unmodified `src/megalinker.cc` and MIT license from
https://github.com/MartinezTorres/megalinker at commit
`18eb466f02e6d14d3efef0fd02d2325b364b28b3`.

The generated project builds this source locally. Override `MEGALINKER` to use
another compatible executable. No dependency is downloaded during a build.
The cartridge startup in `runtime/crt0.s` is an adaptation, not the upstream
startup verbatim; its changes and limitations are described in the project.
